printer.label: Printer

customerCredit.title: Allow customer credit
customerCredit.description: Turn this on to allow Branches to use customer credit.
customerCredit.setupBody: Saving this switch does not approve any customer or create historical balances. Each Branch and customer is enabled separately.
customerCredit.enabledHelp: Branches can use customer credit only when this business switch, the Branch switch, and the customer switch are on.
customerCredit.saved: Customer credit setting saved. POS eligibility has been refreshed.
customerCredit.loadFailed: Customer credit setting could not be loaded.
customerCredit.saveFailed: Customer credit setting could not be saved.

service.label: Service business
service.description: Services, produced items, materials, and simple profit estimates.

previewSaveHint: Preview is visual. Save settings to apply changes to printed documents.

invoiceSettings.title: Invoice Settings
invoiceSettings.subtitle: Configure receipt and invoice appearance
invoiceSettings.businessIdentityHelp: Brand name and logo used on printed documents
invoiceSettings.displayNameHelp: Optional. Replaces the business name in invoice headers. The legal business name remains in the QR code.
invoiceSettings.logoHelp: PNG or JPG, recommended 200×200 px, maximum 2 MB
invoiceSettings.logoUploadHelp: PNG, JPG, or WebP. Maximum 2 MB. Save settings after uploading to apply this logo.
invoiceSettings.logoPendingSave: Logo uploaded. Save settings to keep it on this branch.
invoiceSettings.contactDetailsHelp: Optional contact information for invoices and receipts
invoiceSettings.emailHelp: Shown on invoices when Show Email is enabled
invoiceSettings.websiteHelp: Shown on invoices when Show Website is enabled. Plain domains are saved with https://.
invoiceSettings.websiteHint: You can enter example.com; it will be saved as https://example.com.
invoiceSettings.optionalFieldsHelp: Choose which saved details appear on printed documents
invoiceSettings.cashChangeHelp: Print the change amount on cash receipts
invoiceSettings.footerMessageHelp: Printed at the bottom of thermal and A4 documents
invoiceSettings.footerTextHelp: Custom message printed at the bottom when Show Footer is enabled
invoiceSettings.footerPlaceholder: e.g. Thank you for your business! Visit again.
invoiceSettings.footerShortHint: Keep it short for thermal receipts.
invoiceSettings.defaultPrintActionHelp: Controls the actions shown after checkout. Direct printing uses the thermal receipt format.
invoiceSettings.thermalReceiptHelp: Show the receipt print action after sale
invoiceSettings.a4InvoiceHelp: Show the A4 invoice print action after sale
invoiceSettings.bothActionsHelp: Show receipt and A4 invoice actions
invoiceSettings.fixFields: Fix the highlighted fields before saving.
invoiceSettings.futurePrints: Saved settings apply to future prints and reprints.
invoiceSettings.websiteInvalid: Enter a valid website, such as example.com.
invoiceSettings.phoneInvalid: Use 7–50 digits or phone symbols only.
invoiceSettings.footerTooLong: Footer must be {{count}} characters or fewer.
invoiceSettings.logoTypeInvalid: Upload a PNG, JPG, or WebP logo.
invoiceSettings.documentLanguageHelp: Choose the language used on new invoices, receipts, and credit notes. The preview updates immediately; save to apply it.
invoiceSettings.documentLanguageHistory: Previously issued documents keep their saved language. Older documents without a saved language follow the current branch setting.
invoiceSettings.complianceIdentityVerificationRequired: The compliance identity must be verified.
invoiceSettings.issuanceBlockedIncompleteIdentity: An invoice cannot be issued until the official information is complete.
invoiceSettings.displayDoesNotChangeZatca: Display settings do not change your ZATCA, XML, or QR identity.
invoiceSettings.legacyDocumentRendering: This legacy document uses the legacy rendering path.
invoiceSettings.customerAppearanceHelp: Choose what customers see on new invoices and credit notes.
invoiceSettings.loadFailed: Invoice settings could not be loaded.
invoiceSettings.readOnlyMessage: You can view these invoice settings, but you do not have permission to change them.
invoiceSettings.leaveWarning: You have unsaved invoice settings. Leave without saving?
invoiceSettings.resetDescription: This loads the recommended defaults into your draft. Nothing changes until you save.
invoiceSettings.newDocumentsOnly: Changes apply to new invoices and credit notes. Previously issued documents keep their original appearance.
invoiceSettings.websiteInvalidHttps: Enter a full secure address beginning with https://.
invoiceSettings.websiteHttpsHint: Use a full secure address, for example https://example.com.
invoiceSettings.officialSeparate: Official information is used for ZATCA and is managed separately from invoice appearance.

sections.brandingHelp: These details control how your invoice looks to customers.
sections.contactHelp: Show only the ways customers should use to reach you.
sections.footerHelp: Add short messages that appear at the end of the document.
sections.languageHelp: A language chosen during invoice creation may override this branch default where supported.
sections.thermalHelp: Choose a practical layout for your receipt printer.
sections.a4Help: Choose a representative layout. Final A4 template rendering will be completed in a later phase.
sections.officialHelp: Review the confirmed legal information used for compliant documents.

officialSeller.title: Official Seller Profile
officialSeller.subtitle: Manage the verified legal identity used for future ZATCA XML and QR generation.
officialSeller.notEnabled: Official seller information is not yet available.
officialSeller.displaySafety: Display settings do not change your ZATCA seller identity.
officialSeller.legacyFieldWarning: Official ZATCA seller information is managed from Official Seller Information. Changing this branch display field does not change your confirmed ZATCA seller information.
officialSeller.credentialWarning: Credential impact: changing verified legal information requires revalidation and may require an EGS or certificate compatibility review. Certificates are never regenerated automatically, and existing documents remain unchanged.
officialSeller.activationWarning: Future invoices for this branch will use this verified seller identity for ZATCA XML and QR generation. Existing invoices will not be changed.
officialSeller.recoveryWarning: Returning to legacy mode is an emergency operational action. It does not delete the profile or change issued documents.
officialSeller.strongConfirmation: Future invoices for this branch will use this verified seller identity for ZATCA XML and QR generation. Existing invoices will not be changed. I confirm that I reviewed the official information and understand the credential impact.
officialSeller.actionFailed: The action could not be completed. Review the profile status and try again.
officialSeller.simpleDescription: These are the official details used for ZATCA invoices. Enter them exactly as shown on your VAT certificate or official registration.
officialSeller.simpleCardHelp: Enter and confirm the official seller details used for future ZATCA invoices.
officialSeller.invoiceGuidance: Your invoice appearance can be customized separately. These official details are used for ZATCA.
officialSeller.changeWarning: Changing official information requires confirmation again before it is used for future invoices.

confirmDialog.title: Confirm official information
confirmDialog.message: Check that these details exactly match your VAT certificate or official registration. Future invoices will use these details for ZATCA. Existing invoices will not be changed.
confirmDialog.acknowledgement: I have checked these details and confirm they match my official documents.

validation.vat: Enter a valid 15-digit VAT number beginning and ending with 3.

subscription.lifetimeFreeBody: Your account has full access with no subscription fees.
subscription.activationBody: This workspace needs manual subscription activation. Billing remains available unless the account is suspended.
subscription.graceBody: Grace period active. Billing remains available unless the account is suspended.
subscription.overdueBody: Payment is overdue. Billing remains available during pilot unless the account is suspended.
subscription.suspendedBody: Account suspended. New billing and register opening are disabled. Existing records remain available.
subscription.paymentDueBody: Payment is due soon. Please contact Kubri support if payment is already completed.
subscription.renewUpgrade: To renew or upgrade, contact us:
subscription.updateTiming: We'll update your subscription within a few hours.
